assertions.name: vector_nonet_is_near_ideal
assertions.source: phi is ss-bar to within ~0.5 percentage points: the vector nonet is ideally mixed.

assertions.name: pseudoscalar_nonet_is_far_from_ideal
assertions.source: eta-prime is only ~50% ss-bar: the pseudoscalar nonet sits about as far from ideal mixing as possible.

assertions.name: two_nonets_disagree_on_mixing
assertions.source: The two nonets have identical SU(3) content yet differ by ~0.49 in heavy-state ss-bar purity. No SU(3)-symmetric statement can distinguish them, so the mixing is genuinely extra data -- the content-bearing target.

description: COMPARATOR (not a derivation): convention-free singlet-octet mixing purity of the pseudoscalar and vector meson nonets, from PDG central values. Scores whether the nonet mixing angle is a content-bearing derivation target. It is: the first-order octet ansatz constrains it not at all (NonetMixingUnconstrained.lean, sorry-free), unlike GMO and decuplet equal spacing, which are identities of the ansatz and hence content-free as targets. Two nonets with IDENTICAL SU(3) content sit at nearly opposite extremes: the vector nonet is ideally mixed to ~0.5 percentage points, the pseudoscalar nonet is ~50 pp away. No SU(3)-symmetric statement distinguishes them. Nothing fitted; nothing wired; PDG values are comparators only. The framework cannot currently attempt this -- the singlet is unavailable at dim V = 2 (RowCapObstruction.lean) -- so this scores the TARGET, not prospects.

gmo_deviation_on_physical_states.note: GMO applied to the PHYSICAL states. It nearly works for the pseudoscalar eta (~6%) because that nonet is barely mixed, and fails badly for the physical omega (~32%) because that nonet is ideally mixed, so the physical omega is not the octet member. The failure is a mixing effect, not a failure of SU(3).

data.convention_note: Reported as quark content, not as a mixing angle. Angle conventions differ across the literature (theta_V ~ 39 deg and ~50.8 deg are the same physics under complementary definitions); the ss-bar probability of the heavy state is convention-independent, with ideal mixing exactly 1. The determinant fixes only the SQUARE of the off-diagonal, so both sign branches are computed and the rejected one is recorded rather than silently dropped.
data.honest_scope: Comparator only. This does NOT claim the framework derives the mixing, and it is not evidence for the framework. It establishes that a derivation WOULD be evidence -- which is exactly what the GMO and equal-spacing null results establish is NOT true of those two.
